units.source_text: 且说夕雾大将独自回想柏木临终时遗言，

en.t: Now General Yugiri privately thought back on Kashiwagi's dying words,

units.source_text: 不知究竟是怎么一回事，

en.t: and could not understand what it had really meant,

units.source_text: 很想禀告父亲，看他有何表示。

en.t: so he very much wanted to tell his father and see how he would respond.

units.source_text: 但因他已隐约猜测到几分，

en.t: But because he had already guessed something of the truth,

units.source_text: 所以反而觉得难于启口。

en.t: he found it all the harder to bring himself to speak of it.

units.source_text: 他总想找个机会，探明此事详情，

en.t: He kept wanting to find an opportunity to learn the full details of the matter,

units.source_text: 并把柏木愁苦之状告诉父亲。

en.t: and to tell his father about the sorrow and anguish Kashiwagi had shown.
